text:
sam: Quick check-in before we flip the pricing-gradient canary. Two open items: how to treat customers who recently downgraded (within 14d) and whether to auto-apply small credits (<$100).

iris: For downgrades I'd exclude them from automatic grandfathering because their effective rate changed after T0. Mark them `needs_manual_review`.

ton y: Agree on review flag. For small credits under $100 auto-apply as credit memo to next invoice to reduce ops load. Anything above routes to finance review.

sam: What about tax-aware reporting? We need country breakdown so tax team can reconcile VAT/GST.

iris: I'll include `tax_country` and `estimated_vat` columns in the export. Also add `billing_flow=partner` flag for marketplace-sourced customers.

ton y: SQL I'll run to produce cohorts:```sql
select customer_id, plan, billing_country from subscriptions where status='active' and created_at < '2026-02-01';
```

billing-bot: Tag job scheduled 23:00 UTC. Export will be at https://internal.redwood/exports/1999999012-gradient-canary.csv

sam: Action list: Iris run export + add tax cols (EOD). Tony add review queue and threshold doc. I'll draft short portal message explaining credits and next steps.

iris: On it. Expect ~420 accounts in canary.

billing-bot: Job started at 23:02 UTC  421 accounts tagged.
